title: A Quiet Room

title: Hadean Fire
text: Our voyage begins in the Hadean Eon, more than four billion years ago.
nxt: The young Earth was not the tranquil blue marble we know today, but an incandescent sphere of glowing magma.

title: Garden of Ediacara
text: Life had already learned to build complex cells with dedicated nuclei and internal engines, and after the thaws it blossomed in new ways.

title: Garden of Ediacara
text: By the late Proterozoic, in an enigmatic time called the Ediacaran Period, soft-bodied multicellular creatures drifted through the quiet seabed.

title: Garden of Ediacara
text: They looked like quilted leaves, ribbed discs, and feather-like fronds, lacking eyes, shells, or bones.

title: Garden of Ediacara
text: They rested upon the microbial mats in serene tranquility, living in a world so gentle,
nxt: with few if any hunters, that paleontologists often call it the Garden of Ediacara.

text: Animals grew protective mineralized shells, sharp exoskeletons, and the first complex compound eyes to scan the murky waters.

title: Back to Your Room
text: Take a slow, deep breath and let the quietness of the present settle back into your room.

title: Back to Your Room
text: Isn't it humbling to realize that the calcium in your bones and the iron in your blood were forged in stars, long before this world existed?

title: Back to Your Room
text: You are carrying the legacy of the Archean microbes that learned to make oxygen from sunlight,
nxt: the brave Devonian fish that crawled into the mud, and the tiny burrowing mammals that survived the falling stars.

title: Back to Your Room
text: The ground under your bed is not just stone and soil; it is part of a billions-of-years-old monument to continuous, unbroken survival.

title: Tiny Ripples
text: All the anxieties and busy thoughts that kept you awake tonight are tiny ripples upon the surface of an endless ocean of time.

title: Tiny Ripples
text: The Earth has weathered magma oceans, freezing ice ages, and planetary impacts, and yet, tonight, it cradles you in steady, serene peace.

title: Tiny Ripples
text: You do not have to carry the weight of the world; you simply belong to it, resting safely within its ancient, patient arms.

title: Rest Well
text: As your eyes grow heavy and your thoughts drift into sleep, let the vastness of deep time bring you comfort rather than fear.

title: Rest Well
text: Close your eyes, breathe gently, and rest well tonight, knowing you are a cherished part of this magnificent, living world.
